hrot.description: CE-6003 (city battle O-1) feature terrain: flat ground 200 x 100 m cut in two by a 3 m concrete wall at x = 100 that runs past both edges, with ONE 6 m gate (y 47..53) - the street a roadblock closes. With the gate blocked no ground path joins the two halves; with it open a vehicle (navmesh agent radius 1.8 m) passes. Used by scenarios/showcases/city-battle/features/roadblock-blast. Local metres, X east, Y north, Z up.
